title: kbingest map's dotnet package list step can run repository targets
goal: DotnetMapper no longer runs dotnet package list: with --no-restore it reads no response file, but once ProjectAssetsFile names an existing file (an obj/project.assets.json the repository commits, or a path its own properties set) NuGet builds the targets CollectPackageReferences and CollectCentralPackageVersions, which also runs the project's InitialTargets and any repository target hooked before or after them, while on a fresh checkout it can only fail; packages come from the -getItem:PackageReference evaluation instead, the class docstring stops claiming no target runs, and a test named kbingest_map_dotnet_no_package_list proves no package list call is logged (kb: agents/codebase-mapping.md, the .NET response-file facts from S-dxri4xet, S-ebazgtwi, S-htkjt2zo)
